items.name: Home Assistant Core

current.source: lab Home Assistant, recorded in services/schedule_policy.py (verified 2026-09-30); the live value is ha_sync.STATE.ha_version / health report; the release package matrix still says 2026.9.2

items.note: Monthly releases (first Wednesday-ish) plus weekly patches. We use the WebSocket API (auth, get_states, registries, subscribe_events, auth/current_user, refresh tokens), the REST API (/api/states, /api/services, history), long-lived access tokens, the bridge custom integration (config flow, services, hassio discovery) and entity/area/floor/device registries. The checker parses the 'Backward-incompatible changes' headings of the release notes and the beta notes and matches them against every item's ha_domains. Review 2026-10-21: 2026.10.2 is out (2026.10.0 on 2026-10-07). Lab still recorded at 2026.9.4. 2026.10 breaking changes touching us: Authentication (legacy auth provider mode removed, usernames always normalized to lowercase/trimmed) - verify our HA-username matching is case-insensitive; MQTT publish/dump now admin-only (only matters for the planned Paradox PAI path). Core 2026.11 dev note: auth providers opt in to MFA via MfaLoginFlow; climate/water_heater gain temperature_unit with native_ prefixed properties.
items.impact_he: 2026.10 משנה שלושה דברים שנוגעים בנו: (1) ספק האימות הסיר מצב legacy ושמות משתמש מנורמלים תמיד (אותיות קטנות, בלי רווחים בקצוות); Arx מזהה לפי מזהה משתמש ולכן לא נפגע. (2) mqtt.publish ו-mqtt.dump דורשים מנהל: 'הפעל עכשיו' של סקריפט עם mqtt.publish ייכשל אצל משתמש שאינו מנהל. (3) תנאי מצב עם for יחד עם מאפיין, רשימת מצבים או מצב מישות אחרת נכשלים באימות התצורה. תיקון 2026.10.1 מחזיר TLS לא מאומת למקורות stream עם אפשרות verify_ssl. המעבדה ושער WisKey נשארים על 2026.9.4 עד אישור. פירוט: docs/operations/HA_2026_10_COMPATIBILITY_HE.md.

items.name: Home Assistant Supervisor

current.source: docs/release/RELEASE_PACKAGE_V1.md compatibility matrix (HAOS 18.2, Supervisor 2026.09.2 on the amd64 lab host); the live value may have moved: verify

items.note: Add-on runtime: Ingress (ingress, ingress_port, panel_*), hassio_api + homeassistant_api roles, discovery of the bridge, /addons/self/options and /addons/self/restart (settings screen), CR-021 S3 (hassio_role: manager): POST /store/addons/{slug}/update, GET /jobs/info, GET /core/info, POST /core/check, POST /core/restart (the allow-list in services/self_update.py; watch for role-regex changes, the self bypass and /v2 aliases), backup: hot, watchdog, the map: homeassistant_config copy of the bridge. build.yaml is kept only for Supervisors older than 2026.04 (newer ones read the base image from the Dockerfile). HA is moving the name add-ons -> apps (the cloudflared repo is homeassistant-apps/app-cloudflared): watch for config key or API renames. Review 2026-10-21: 2026.10.3 is out. 2026.10.2 (#7308) enforces panel_admin for ingress sessions (non-admin gets 403 on admin-only panels). Our add-on declares panel_admin false, so non-admin ingress should be unaffected, but this must be confirmed with a real non-admin ingress session on a 2026.10 Supervisor. 2026.10.1 rejects WebSocket batches with denied commands in the HA proxy and uses a sliding expiry for ingress sessions.
items.impact_he: אין שינוי שובר מתועד. Ingress: חלון תפוגה נע ל-session. ה-proxy של WebSocket דוחה אצוות עם פקודות אסורות. Network API v2 ושמות תיקיות v2 אינם בשימוש אצלנו (self_update משתמש ב-v1). לבדוק בעשן: עדכון עצמי ו-Ingress.

items.name: ha-whatsapp (FaserF; unofficial WhatsApp add-on + HA integration, used by the tickets module)

current.source: installed as an add-on and an integration on the owner's Home Assistant (CR-038); the installed version is not recorded and the live checks of docs/changes/CR-038-S5A-NOTES.md and CR-038-S5B-NOTES.md (UNVERIFIED sections) have not been run

items.note: Unofficial WhatsApp client (Baileys): number bans, no delivery receipts, logout when the phone does not connect for 14 days. The tickets module calls only whatsapp.send_message and whatsapp.send_buttons with the account (config entry id) and listens to whatsapp_message_received / whatsapp_button_pressed; it reads the connectivity binary sensor (unique_id <entry_id>_connection) from the entity mirror. Every fact about it in CR-038 section 4.1 marked [WA-SRC] is unverified on the owner's installation until the live checks (private/planning/TICKETS_WHATSAPP_LIVE_CHECKS_HE.md) run. A change in the service fields, the event fields, the entity ids or the account resolution breaks the ticket message channel.
